single_owned_native_attempt: Only after Sol reviews the fresh worker and the Truss owner confirms a quiet native window, start one fresh isolated local PostgreSQL 18.6 host in a new private attempt directory using the exact 0.0.48 [local,native] profile. Do not reuse the failed host or the 0.0.45 database.

The worker must complete and verify source preparation before PG startup, then make one public accept_in_transaction call with the same live prepared object, a fresh request key, expected revision, and expected document set.

After commit, use read-only status_in_transaction, report_in_transaction, accepted_document_in_transaction, and catalog_view_in_transaction to verify the accepted document, report, source bytes, catalog revision, and complete view.

Retain a bounded private receipt with source/readback digests and typed outcomes. Stop the host and verify process termination; preserve the bounded private data directory and exact receipt through review, then remove only this attempt-owned directory under an explicit owner cleanup step. Stop before object or edge creation, feed, publication, destination, query, ACK, or source migration.

resource_and_stop_bounds.failure_rule: On timeout or uncertain acceptance, stop effects and reconcile only through the exact public read-only status/report/source/view methods while retaining the original host if healthy; if a restart is necessary, reopen only the same attempt-owned data directory for readback. Preserve unresolved uncertainty, stop the host, and do not replay acceptance or proceed to graph mutations.
resource_and_stop_bounds.timeout_authority: Use the installed public PsycopgHost defaults for catalog acceptance and readback. Initial installation uses its exact release installer/migration profile and separately recorded finite bounds; the outer 600-second supervisor deadline is a containment ceiling, not permission to extend catalog SQL or operation timeouts. Do not raise these limits to obtain a pass.
resource_and_stop_bounds.quiet_window: Required before any native host start; verify no owner-owned PostgreSQL campaign is active and keep all Ashlar work sequential.
resource_and_stop_bounds.storage_and_cleanup: Preflight a fresh owner-named private directory with at least 1 GiB free and a monitored 1 GiB directory ceiling, unique socket/port and exact owner. Record startup and stop markers; stop if the ceiling is approached. Retain the stopped directory and bounded receipt through outcome review, then remove only this attempt-owned temporary storage under an explicit owner cleanup step.
